# BenchmarkRoute

Which way a [`BenchmarkConfig`](BenchmarkConfig.md)'s run goes.

## Values

- `auto`: A tour of the world's planet when it has one and the config authors none of its route, else the config's own route.
- `legs`: The config's own `travel`, `turn` and `boom` legs.
- `planet_tour`: A tour of the world's planet, as `tour` describes.
